query: How can I appeal if my Singapore Permanent Residence (PR) application is rejected or unsuccessful?
reference_answer: You may consider submitting a fresh application for permanent residence online if there are changes to your circumstances.
answer: To appeal a rejected Singapore Permanent Residence (PR) application, you need to submit a written appeal letter within 30 days of receiving the rejection notice. Ensure you address all points raised in the rejection letter and provide additional relevant documentation. [Document 1]
